items.text: Terry McLaurin active (limited expected) vs Giants; Jayden Daniels also returning.

items.implication: Start as RB1/2 but monitor snaps; elevated RB if limited.
items.opportunity: Lead back role if healthy enough; handcuff elevated in case.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase will play (final update from questionable).
